# ZenWebsocket v0.4.2 - Table of Contents

A robust WebSocket client library for Elixir, built on Gun transport for production-grade
reliability. Designed for financial APIs with automatic reconnection, comprehensive error
handling, and real-world testing.

## Modules

- [ZenWebsocket](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.md): A robust WebSocket client library for Elixir, built on Gun transport.
- [ZenWebsocket.Client](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Client.md): WebSocket client GenServer using Gun as transport layer.
- [ZenWebsocket.ClientSupervisor](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.ClientSupervisor.md): Optional supervisor for WebSocket client connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.Config](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Config.md): Configuration struct for WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.ConnectionRegistry](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.ConnectionRegistry.md): ETS-based connection tracking without GenServer.

- [ZenWebsocket.Debug](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Debug.md): Conditional debug logging for ZenWebsocket.
- [ZenWebsocket.ErrorHandler](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.ErrorHandler.md): Simple error handling for WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.AdapterSupervisor](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.AdapterSupervisor.md): Supervisor for WebSocket adapters with fault tolerance.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.BatchSubscriptionManager](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.BatchSubscriptionManager.md): Simple batch subscription manager for efficiently subscribing to multiple channels.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitAdapter](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitAdapter.md): Simplified Deribit WebSocket API adapter.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitGenServerAdapter](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitGenServerAdapter.md): Production-ready supervised Deribit adapter with automatic reconnection.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitRpc](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.DeribitRpc.md): Shared Deribit JSON-RPC method definitions and request builders.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.BasicUsage](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.BasicUsage.md): Basic usage examples from the documentation.
These examples demonstrate simple WebSocket connections and message handling.

- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.ErrorHandling](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.ErrorHandling.md): Error handling and retry patterns from Examples.md

- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.JsonRpcClient](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.JsonRpcClient.md): JSON-RPC client example from documentation.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.SubscriptionManagement](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.Docs.SubscriptionManagement.md): Examples of subscription management with WebSocket connections.

- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.PlatformAdapterTemplate](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.PlatformAdapterTemplate.md): Minimal template for creating platform-specific WebSocket adapters.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.SupervisedClient](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.SupervisedClient.md): Basic WebSocket client supervision example.
- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.UsagePatterns](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.UsagePatterns.md): Examples of different WebSocket client usage patterns.
This module demonstrates three ways to use ZenWebsocket:
1. Direct connection (no supervision)
2. Using ClientSupervisor
3. Direct supervision in your app

- [ZenWebsocket.Examples.UsagePatterns.ExampleApp](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Examples.UsagePatterns.ExampleApp.md): Example application module demonstrating all WebSocket connection patterns.
- [ZenWebsocket.Frame](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Frame.md): WebSocket frame encoding and decoding utilities.
- [ZenWebsocket.HeartbeatManager](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.HeartbeatManager.md): Manages heartbeat lifecycle for WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.Helpers.Deribit](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Helpers.Deribit.md): Helper functions for Deribit-specific WebSocket operations.

- [ZenWebsocket.JsonRpc](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.JsonRpc.md): JSON-RPC 2.0 request builder and response matcher.
- [ZenWebsocket.LatencyStats](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.LatencyStats.md): Bounded circular buffer for latency statistics calculation.
- [ZenWebsocket.MessageHandler](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.MessageHandler.md): Message handling utilities for WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.PoolRouter](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.PoolRouter.md): Health-based connection routing for WebSocket client pools.
- [ZenWebsocket.RateLimiter](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.RateLimiter.md): Token bucket rate limiter for WebSocket API calls.
- [ZenWebsocket.Reconnection](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Reconnection.md): Internal reconnection helper for Client GenServer.
- [ZenWebsocket.Recorder](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Recorder.md): Pure functions for WebSocket session recording and replay.
- [ZenWebsocket.RecorderServer](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.RecorderServer.md): Async GenServer for recording WebSocket sessions to JSONL files.
- [ZenWebsocket.RequestCorrelator](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.RequestCorrelator.md): Manages request/response correlation for JSON-RPC WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.SubscriptionManager](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.SubscriptionManager.md): Manages subscription tracking for WebSocket connections.
- [ZenWebsocket.Testing](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/ZenWebsocket.Testing.md): Test helpers for consumers testing ZenWebsocket integrations.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix stability_test](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.StabilityTest.md): Runs stability tests for ZenWebsocket with Deribit integration.
- [mix zen_websocket.usage](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ZenWebsocket.Usage.md): Mix task to export ZenWebsocket usage rules for AI agents and developers.
- [mix zen_websocket.validate_usage](https://zen-websocket.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ZenWebsocket.ValidateUsage.md): Validates that code follows ZenWebsocket usage rules.
